extraction.Name: Joseph Larvie
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: There were no debts settled in the transaction
extraction.NOTES: Satisfied with the sale; cash deal; sold for $5600.00; has three children; did not ask for the patent; states 'This patent was issued me too soon and I should like to get the land back if there is any chance'; received patent from the farmer at Black Pipe; does not remember signing a receipt; subscribed and sworn June 4, 1929; notary commission expires 4-28-32
